name: DecisionSchemaCatalog

test_list.description: Validated SDK snapshots retain the versioned questions, policy, thresholds, and calibration state.
Malformed question ids and calibration provenance are rejected at construction.
The L3 adapter maps the canonical skill schema into an SDK snapshot without losing policy metadata.
Catalog absence is distinct from adapter validation failure.
Calibration fixture/checkpoint hashes, sample count, quality values, and date survive adaptation.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Exact schema version for get; latest resolves the highest installed version.

output_description: Owned, validated SDK schema snapshot with questions, input bounds, thresholds, failure policy, and calibration provenance.
